original_value: The Partnership on AI to Benefit People and Society (or PAI) is a consortium of industrial, non-profit, and academic partners for promoting public understanding and beneficial use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies. Primary goals of the PAI are "to study and formulate best practices on AI technologies, to advance the public's understanding of AI, and to serve as an open platform for discussion and engagement about AI and its influences on people and society."

result.paraphrase: The Partnership on AI to Benefit People and Society (PAI) is a consortium of industrial, nonprofit, and academic partners that promotes public understanding and the beneficial use of artificial intelligence technologies. Its main goals are to study and develop best practices for AI technologies, advance the public’s understanding of AI, and provide an open platform for discussion and engagement on AI and its effects on people and society.
